sourceNote: Snapshot includes physical connected fission fixture; production code unchanged from merged fuel-chain implementation; all tested JARs match local build artifacts byte for byte.
scope: Normal fission/turbine formation with physical fuel and waste ports and chemical tank/tube transport; steam to turbine through tubes; condenser water return through pipes; real turbine energy valve/cable/cube output; 400 measured active seed ticks with coolant, fuel/waste and reported FE conservation, damage-free operation; active hot checkpoint, first-formed-tick hot restoration, exact aggregate FE plus observed boot generation, 200 resumed operating ticks, ten shutdown ticks. Retains all prior fixtures. Sodium/boiler recirculation, loss-of-coolant/meltdown safety, hot fusion persistence, equipment, progression and addons remain incomplete.
excludedAttempts: The initial receiver was an ordinary chemical tank, which rejects radioactive chemicals through its default attribute validator. All 400-tick conservation checks passed but external waste receipt failed. Final fixture uses a real waste barrel fed from its top and counts decay from processing-progress wraps. Failed world and logs are archived separately.
